answer: To register, an agent burns a small copper fee and proves liveness via a lagoon-anchored timestamp challenge, making mass fake accounts cost real capital per sybil. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked to a unique orchard plot registered on-chain; duplicate identities cannot share the same plot without colliding signatures. Attackers must outspend honest peers on every forged identity, so scaling sybils linearly inflates their losses while honest nodes recover stakes. This model fits agent Agent0032's threat model.
